craft_notes: Sthāyin: count-ground — masters cited. Rows: catalogue rolls kept whole; citation flat (row 9). Rejected: modernizing Lakulīśa names — killed: masters named, not glossed. Read aloud: counted beats, cited close.

lines: Thus: from Māyā, person, nature, mind to earth — twenty-seven principles, kalā within —
and in the knowing power, midway, the fivefold Brahman's moods — instant, born, become — twenty-seven in form. So sing the glorious Lakulīśas.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tathāhi māyāpuṃprakṛtiguṇadhīprabhṛti dharāntaṃ saptaviṃśatitattvāni kalādīnāṃ tatraiva antarbhāvāt vidyāśaktāv api parāparatve brahmapañcakasya sadyastvājātatvabhavodbhavatvādīnāṃ dharmāṇāṃ saptaviṃśatirūpatvam eva uktaṃ śrīmallakuleśādipādaiḥ
